packageRules.description: rand_core is a dev-dependency only because rsa 0.9 wants an rng from it, and rsa 0.9 is pinned to the rand_core 0.6 API: 0.9+ does not compile against it. Hold until rsa releases on the new rand_core, then drop this rule. See LFSX#307 and LFSX#317.

tracing-opentelemetry decides which opentelemetry this server can use: 0.33.0, the newest, requires opentelemetry ^0.32. Bumping the monorepo alone stops the crate compiling (SdkTracer no longer satisfies the Tracer bound the layer needs), so the cap goes with the bridge. Lift both together the day tracing-opentelemetry supports 0.33.

TypeScript 7 is outside Angular's supported range: @angular/compiler-cli 22 declares `typescript: >=6.0 <6.1`, and the compiler errors out rather than warns on an unsupported version. Hold at 6.x until Angular ships support, then drop this rule. See FerrLabs/.github#313.
